listings.title: Stylish Liverpool Apartment with Parking & Balcony
listings.description:
Discover Liverpool in style in this charming two-bedroom apartment, ideally located near the Hilton Hotel and John Lewis. It features a private balcony, two bathrooms, a sofa bed, superfast WiFi, Smart TV and a fully equipped kitchen. Secure underground parking is included. Perfect for families, couples or professionals, with easy access to Liverpool ONE, Albert Dock and the city’s shops, restaurants and attractions.

The space
The living room is designed for relaxation, featuring a large corner sofa that converts into a comfortable bed, allowing the apartment to sleep up to six guests in total. Entertainment is provided with a 50” Samsung Smart TV, while superfast Hyperoptic Wi-Fi is available throughout the apartment, ideal for both remote working and streaming your favourite apps and shows.

The bright open-plan living space also offers direct access to the balcony through impressive floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to fill the apartment and creating a bright, airy atmosphere throughout the day.

Sharing the same open-plan space is the modern kitchen and dining area. A stylish breakfast bar doubles as a dining table, complete with five matching chairs, making it perfect for casual dining, morning coffee, or socialising while cooking. The kitchen is well-equipped with modern appliances including an oven, hob, microwave, toaster, kettle, washing machine, dishwasher, and Nespresso coffee machine, providing everything needed for a convenient self-catered stay.

The apartment features two spacious bedrooms, each furnished with a comfortable double bed and ample storage including wardrobes and drawers. Both bedrooms are carpeted for added comfort and finished with elegant grey-accented furnishings, creating a modern yet timeless aesthetic. The master bedroom also benefits from private balcony access, offering a peaceful outdoor space to enjoy fresh air and city views. It further includes a contemporary en-suite bathroom complete with a rain shower, handheld shower attachment, washbasin, and WC.

The main bathroom is equally stylish and includes a full-sized bath with an overhead rain shower and additional handheld shower, alongside a WC, washbasin, and mirror with vanity space.

Ideal for families, couples, and professionals alike, the apartment offers easy access to Liverpool ONE, the Albert Dock, and the city’s excellent selection of shops, restaurants, bars, and attractions, making it a convenient and comfortable base for any stay in Liverpool.

Guest access
You'll have exclusive access to the entire apartment during your stay. This includes both bedrooms, the living room, two full bathrooms, the kitchen, and the patio or balcony. We offer a remote check-in process, but we're always available via phone or message if you need anything. You'll receive key collection instructions the day before your arrival.

Other things to note
Our support hours are from 9am to 9pm, with limited emergency assistance available outside these times.

The apartment is on the first floor within a residential complex. Parties, loud music, and events are strictly not permitted.

Bookings for groups where all guests are under 25 cannot be accepted.

Smoking is not allowed and will result in an additional charge.

Lost Property: Any items left behind after check-out will be stored for up to 10 days. If they are not claimed or arrangements for collection or postage are not made within this time, they will be disposed of. Any postage costs for returning lost items are the responsibility of the guest.

Check-in is from 3pm and check-out is by 11am. Late check-outs without prior approval may incur a fee.

Linens and towels are provided for each guest.

While the building does have a lift, we cannot guarantee it will be operational during your stay. This has not been an issue to date, but we want to be transparent.

Please do not have parcels sent to the apartment. We cannot take responsibility for missing or damaged deliveries.

In rare cases of essential maintenance, access may be required during your stay. We’ll always give at least 24 hours’ notice unless immediate attention is required.

listings.title: Apartment in Merseyside
listings.description:
Step into this stylish penthouse retreat by the water. A serene escape tucked just beyond the buzz of the city. Featuring free parking, two spacious double bedrooms with generous walk-in wardrobes, including one with a private en-suite, a cosy lounge with a 50” 4K smart TV, and a fully-equipped kitchen, it’s the perfect place to unwind in comfort.

The space
Whether you’re cooking a relaxed meal at home or heading out to enjoy the vibrant food and drink scene at the nearby Albert Dock, this property gives you the best of both worlds. Pour a glass of wine and take in the stunning marina views from your own south-facing balcony, perfect for a quiet evening or catching the sunset.

As this apartment is part of a quiet, well-maintained residential building, we kindly ask that all guests are mindful of neighbours at all times. Noise should be kept to a minimum both in the apartment and shared areas of the building. Any disregard for this may lead to early termination of your stay.

This property is NOT suitable for party groups or events.

Guests are not permitted to use the balcony between the hours of 10pm-8am. There is no smoking allowed on the balcony at any time. To smoke you must exit the building.

Guest access
You will collect your keys from a lockbox local to the property, from there you enter the building, take the lift up to the top floor and enter your apartment. Be prepared to say 'wow'! As you see the stunning views for the first time.

Other things to note
Lost Property: Any items left behind after check-out will be stored for up to 10 days. If they are not claimed or arrangements for collection or postage are not made within this time, they will be disposed of. Any postage costs for returning lost items are the responsibility of the guest.

listings.title: Prestwich: 4-Bedroom Home | Amazing for Groups
listings.description:
Enjoy a stay in this newly renovated 4-bedroom home, comfortably sleeping up to 8 guests with double beds in each bedroom. A spacious and modern base for families, groups or work stays.

No parties or events allowed. Photo ID may be required.

The space
This spacious 4-bedroom home near Heaton Park comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests, making it ideal for families or small groups travelling together.

Bedrooms
• 4 comfortable bedrooms, each with a double bed

Living space
• Fully equipped modern kitchen for cooking and dining
• Bright and spacious living area perfect for relaxing together

Bathrooms
• Full family bathroom
• Additional separate toilet for extra convenience

Additional features
• Private driveway parking for up to 3 cars
• Fast, reliable Wi-Fi throughout the house
• Pet-friendly accommodation

Family-friendly extra
• Travel cot available on request (£10 fee with notice)

A comfortable base for visiting Heaton Park, exploring Prestwich Village, or travelling into Manchester City Centre.

Guest access
The property has a key safe. The property check-in details will be sent the morning of your booking.

Check-in is anytime from 3PM. The check-in details will be sent on the morning of your booking, once the current guest checks out.

Please confirm your email address via messenger tab on Airbnb for the property manual to be sent over on the morning of your check-in.

Early check-ins / late check-outs must be pre-approved before making your booking.

Other things to note
PETS:
- Pets must be approved and paid for (no birds allowed).
- Please keep all pets off the sofas, or alternatively, lay down a blanket on top of the sofa beforehand.
- We do not provide any pet essentials, so guests will need to bring their own blankets, litter tray etc.
- Any litter trays will need to stay on the lower floor, inside the hallway.

CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT:
- Early check-in or late check out is not guaranteed and must be pre-approved before booking.

VISITORS:
- No visitors are allowed after 10PM.

- Parties & gatherings are strictly forbidden - Bookings will be canceled immediately with no refund and you will need to leave the property.

LOST KEYS:
- If keys are lost, a locksmith callout is required, or you fail to return the keys to the key safe upon check-out, a fee of £150 will be charged to your account.

PARKING:

DAMAGE DEPOSIT:
- Please note that a refundable security deposit of up to £400 may be required prior to receiving check-in details.

- The exact deposit amount is determined at the host’s discretion, based on factors such as the guest’s booking history, profile verification, and previous reviews.

- We require a mandatory £500 refundable security deposit, during festival season.

- This deposit serves as a safeguard against potential damages, breaches of house rules, or excessive cleaning requirements. It will be fully refunded within 48 hours of check-out, provided the property is left in good condition and no issues are reported.

- Guests will be notified in advance if a deposit is required and provided with clear instructions for payment and refund processing.

- By confirming your booking, you acknowledge and agree to these terms.
